steps.what: Establish invention facts, contributors, experimental support and unresolved technical distinctions
Prepare disclosure or application technical sections from the invention evidence brief

loop.purpose: Draft technical narrative without inventing experimental support or legal conclusions.
loop.input: Evidence brief, referenced notebook passages and the current technical template.
loop.output: Draft sections with factual provenance and explicit gaps.
loop.check: Engineer verifies every described embodiment, result and claimed technical distinction against source records; no unsupported scope or inventorship conclusion is accepted.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; missing support or confidentiality restrictions return to manual drafting.
loop.why_not_simpler: Try native form fields first; explanatory technical narrative varies between inventions.

steps.what: Verify disclosures for technical accuracy and send the checked contribution to patent counsel

tasks.design: Use native forms in {DOCS} first, then bounded drafting for technical descriptions grounded in the engineer's evidence brief. The engineer checks the technical contribution before counsel handles legal scope and filing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical evidence must be turned into a coherent description without losing qualifications.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-grounded drafting can assist wording while preserving evidence links and visible gaps.
tasks.still_hard: Inventorship, disclosure strategy and claim scope require separate specialist judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer distinguishes demonstrated facts from hypotheses and explains the actual invention.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft prose; technical accuracy and counsel decisions retain their owners.

reach.task: Assess protection strategy and prepare claims
reach.learn: Explain technical distinctions without substituting engineering judgement for legal advice.

evidence.claim: Grounded drafting of technical invention descriptions is model knowledge; no digest case demonstrates patent quality or labour savings.

assumptions: Boundary is the engineer's technical contribution; legal review, claim drafting authority and external filing remain outside and receive no savings.

Engineer produces invention title, contributor statements, dated source references, embodiments, observed results, limitations and unresolved distinctions in s1. Capture is counted; unsupported sections are drafted manually or left as questions.
Native confidential forms precede model drafting. Permission to process confidential invention material must be confirmed; absent permission use manual drafting.
unknowns: Existing disclosure forms and counsel requirements
research_questions: Can reviewers trace every technical statement to an actual dated record?

already_counted.description: Final technical accuracy check and handoff.

incremental.description: Maintain source-grounding checks and technical templates.
Counsel and document administration review template changes; ordinary legal review stays outside baseline.

approvals.approved_version: Exact technical contribution and evidence references; edits invalidate technical sign-off.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=87.75 gross=12.25 net=6.25 after 6 upkeep. Zero if confidentiality precludes drafting; 2 for a supported repeatable technical section with unchanged counsel effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Reengineer nanomaterials through degradation hypotheses, material changes and experimental interpretation

tasks.design: Retain material redesign and experimental interpretation with the engineer, recording the rationale in {DOCS}. Existing analysis tools support investigation, while degradation products and application performance require physical evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Changes that promote degradation may impair performance or create undesirable products.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support comparison, without removing the need for experimental reasoning.
tasks.still_hard: Laboratory degradation may not predict behaviour in the intended environment.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer selects relevant conditions and weighs competing material properties.
tasks.altitude: No assumed change in research effort or material approval rights.

reach.learn: Choose realistic environmental conditions and account for transformation products.

evidence.claim: Retaining biodegradability research and redesign is model knowledge; no task-specific saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is engineering research and redesign, excluding independent certification and production changes.
Engineer investigates composition and observations in s1; no structured biodegradability or environmental safety flag is assumed.
Consider native analysis tools first. Zero upkeep because no new automation or capture process is introduced.
research_questions: Does the proposed material retain application performance under realistic degradation conditions?

already_counted.description: All redesign and experimental reasoning remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. Experimental redesign remains unchanged without an invented paperwork baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Integrate antimicrobial nanotechnology while investigating product compatibility, exposure and microbial performance

tasks.design: Keep product integration and evidence interpretation with the engineer using {DOCS} for design records. Existing material analysis supports the work, while antimicrobial performance and exposure implications remain application-specific.
tasks.previous_blocker: Effective antimicrobial action does not establish compatibility or acceptable exposure in a finished product.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing research records help compare options without replacing product testing.
tasks.still_hard: Coatings can wear, release material or perform differently under actual use conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer challenges performance claims against realistic use and failure conditions.
tasks.altitude: No assumed change in product engineering workload.

reach.learn: Define relevant microbial test conditions and exposure questions.

evidence.claim: Application-specific antimicrobial integration remains engineering work, based on model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is technical integration design; medical claims, market release and specialist biological assessments remain separate.
Engineer assesses raw research and test observations during s1; no automatic efficacy or safety classification is assumed.
Consider existing native analysis first. Zero additional upkeep because this proposal introduces no automation.
research_questions: Does performance persist under realistic wear and cleaning without unacceptable material release?

already_counted.description: Integration investigation and design remain fully counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. No product-specific engineering or physical evidence work is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop catalysis and synthesis methods through reaction investigation and experimental engineering

tasks.design: Retain catalytic and green-chemistry method development with the engineer and document its evidence in {DOCS}. Existing analysis assists comparisons, while yield, purity, hazards and scale-up remain experimental engineering questions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reaction behaviour and desired nanostructure depend on conditions not captured by general rules.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing analytical tools support investigation without establishing a new autonomous synthesis capability.
tasks.still_hard: A route with a greener reagent may have worse yield, energy demand or waste overall.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer chooses experiments and evaluates the whole process tradeoff.
tasks.altitude: No assumed reduction in synthesis research effort.

reach.learn: Translate laboratory observations into heat, mass-transfer and process constraints.

evidence.claim: Retaining novel nanomaterial synthesis development is model knowledge; no task-specific measured saving is claimed.

assumptions: Boundary is synthesis method development; plant implementation and formal process acceptance are outside this task.
Engineer investigates reaction evidence and material characterisation within s1; no ready-made green-process or reaction-success flag is assumed.
Native analysis precedes custom tooling. Zero upkeep because no new workflow or model is introduced.
research_questions: Which route improves measured yield and overall resource use under comparable conditions?

already_counted.description: All synthesis investigation and engineering are retained.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. No experimental engineering work is replaced by document generation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Technical disclosure preparation may shorten while material research and engineering judgement remain intact.
reach: Work with patent counsel on factual technical contributions and chemical engineers on synthesis scale-up.
role.ambitious_version: An engineer whose technical descriptions preserve evidence and whose material improvements survive realistic testing.
